basics.name: Chulwon Park
basics.label: Incoming Ph.D. Student at Indiana University Bloomington
basics.summary: Incoming Ph.D. student in Economics at Indiana University Bloomington (starting Fall 2026). My research interests include Macroeconomics, International Finance, and Econometrics, with a focus on monetary and fiscal policy transmission, global financial cycles, and the economic impact of climate shocks using satellite data.
